hank.name: Initial Setup Codon
hank.promptText: Create a directory called 'large_content' in <%PROJECT_DIR%> if it doesn't exist. Then create an empty file at <%PROJECT_DIR%>/large_content/setup_complete.txt with the text 'Setup complete'.

hank.name: Context Exhaustion Loop
hank.description: Loop that generates massive amounts of content to exhaust context

codons.name: Generate Large Content
codons.promptText: Generate a VERY LONG detailed analysis (at least 45000 words) about a random topic and save it to <%PROJECT_DIR%>/large_content/content_<TIMESTAMP>.md. Include extensive code examples, detailed explanations, and comprehensive documentation. Make each iteration completely different with unique content.

codons.name: Analyze Content
codons.promptText: Read ALL the content files in <%PROJECT_DIR%>/large_content/ and write a comprehensive 23000+ word analysis comparing them all. Save your analysis to <%PROJECT_DIR%>/large_content/analysis_<TIMESTAMP>.md. Reference specific details from each file.

hank.name: Final Codon After Loop
hank.promptText: Create a summary file at <%PROJECT_DIR%>/large_content/final_summary.txt with the text 'Loop completed due to context exceeded. Final codon executed successfully.'
hank.description: Final codon to verify workflow continues
